I have completed the task for case **c11** ([`Field Kiln Everyday Teapot`](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/evals/runs/2026-11-02-current-skill-automation/cases/c11/index.html)) following all constraints.

### Summary of Completed Work

1. **Craft Identity & UI Structure**:
   - Built a ceramic studio craft layout in [`index.html`](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/evals/runs/2026-11-02-current-skill-automation/cases/c11/index.html) and [`styles.css`](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/evals/runs/2026-11-02-current-skill-automation/cases/c11/styles.css) using warm stoneware tones, editorial serif typography, and tactile control states.
   - Embedded [`assets/teapot.svg`](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/evals/runs/2026-11-02-current-skill-automation/cases/c11/assets/teapot.svg) with explicit visual disclosures stating it is an original vector illustration of a fictional product.
   - Displayed all practical details discoverable prior to purchase without requiring hover interactions: material, dimensions, capacity, care instructions, dispatch timeline, flat shipping rate, and return policy.

2. **Interactivity & Behavior Contract**:
   - Sourced all product data directly from [`fixture.json`](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/evals/runs/2026-11-02-current-skill-automation/cases/c11/fixture.json) in [`app.js`](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/evals/runs/2026-11-02-current-skill-automation/cases/c11/app.js) with no simulated scarcity or fabricated reviews.
   - Initial state defaults to **Iron** glaze and quantity **1** ($76.00 total).
   - **Ash** is unavailable (`stock: 0`), marked with `disabled` and `aria-disabled="true"`, styled as sold out, and programmatically blocked from being selected or purchased.
   - Dynamic order total calculation updates cleanly on quantity changes: base USD 68.00 + shipping USD 8.00 (e.g. Sand × 2 totals **USD 144.00**), visible both in the breakdown summary and on the add-to-cart button before checkout.
   - Adding Sand × 2 produces a visible confirmation inside the feedback region containing the glaze name, quantity, and full order total.

3. **Neutral Test Hooks**:
   - `data-testid="glaze-iron"`, `glaze-ash"`, and `glaze-sand"` on glaze selection buttons.
   - `data-testid="quantity"` on the quantity selector (options 1–4).
   - `data-testid="add-to-cart"` on the purchase action button.
   - `data-testid="cart-status"` on the visible confirmation region (`aria-live="polite"`).

4. **Self-Review & Notes**:
   - Executed the offline static audit tool (`tasteforge audit --path .`): 0 errors, 0 warnings.
   - Executed the single allowed preview capture (`preview.mjs c11`) and visually inspected the desktop/mobile screenshots in `evidence/self-review/` using `read_file`.
   - Performed one review revision to improve glaze legend spacing, stock status line wrapping, and mobile price label wrapping.
   - Documented decisions and verifications honestly in [`implementation-notes.md`](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/evals/runs/2026-11-02-current-skill-automation/cases/c11/implementation-notes.md).
   - Preserved [`task.md`](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/evals/runs/2026-11-02-current-skill-automation/cases/c11/task.md) and [`fixture.json`](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/evals/runs/2026-11-02-current-skill-automation/cases/c11/fixture.json) untouched.
